title: Lead Logistics Customer Experience and Operations Specialist
description:
Execute and manage end\-to\-end SCM operational activities including shipment tracking, milestone updates, reporting, validation and exception handling.
  

Support 3PL and 4PL operational workflows including vendor coordination, customer updates, visibility reporting and operational follow\-ups.
  

Support DCM\-related activities including container visibility, destination milestone monitoring, demurrage/detention input tracking, reporting and customer/status updates where applicable.

Maintain high\-quality communication standards by ensuring timely responses, clear follow\-ups and proper escalation of exceptions.
  

Track operational KPIs such as timeliness, accuracy, productivity, SLA adherence and quality of output.
  

Support RCA preparation for process deviations, missed SLA, reporting errors and customer escalations.
  

Assist in automation and AI initiatives by preparing input files, validating outputs, testing automation results and providing process feedback.
  

Maintain SOPs, IOPs, trackers and process documentation to ensure consistency, compliance and business continuity.
  

Participate in training, cross\-skilling and knowledge\-sharing activities to support team resilience and backup readiness.
  

Execute additional operational tasks assigned by the Team Leader / Manager based on business priorities.  



  

Required qualification, experience \& skills


Graduate with 3–5 years of relevant experience in SCM, logistics, freight forwarding or shared services operations.
  

Working knowledge of 3PL / 4PL supply chain operations, shipment lifecycle, milestone tracking and reporting.
  

Basic understanding of DCM / destination management activities will be an advantage.
  

Strong written communication skills with experience in customer / stakeholder email handling.
  

Good MS Excel skills; exposure to Power BI, Power Automate, AI tools or reporting automation preferred.
  

Strong attention to detail, ownership mindset, time management and ability to work under pressure.  



  

Required Business/ Technical Knowledge


SCM operations: import/export flows, milestone tracking, PO/shipment visibility, reporting and exception handling.
  

Customer communication: ability to draft clear, professional and timely email responses.
  

Reporting: ability to prepare, validate and maintain operational and KPI reports in Excel.
  

Automation support: ability to support testing, validation and adoption of AI / Power Automate / reporting automation outputs.
  

Process documentation: ability to follow and maintain SOPs, IOPs, trackers and training materials

title: Cinema Advertisement Operations - Manager
description:
**Job** ***Summary***  

  

The Cinema Advertisement Operations Manager is responsible for the end\-to\-end execution, monitoring, and delivery of cinema advertising campaigns across a network of theatres. The role ensures seamless campaign scheduling, content deployment, playback monitoring, compliance with client requirements, billing support, and operational excellence. The position serves as a critical link between Sales, Clients, Theatre Partners, Technology, and Finance teams to ensure successful campaign delivery and revenue realization.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**Campaign Operations \& Execution*** Manage the end\-to\-end lifecycle of cinema advertising campaigns.
* Coordinate campaign scheduling, deployment, monitoring, and closure activities.
* Ensure advertisements are delivered as per approved schedules and contracts.
* Monitor campaign start and end dates to ensure uninterrupted execution.
* Coordinate with theatre partners for campaign implementation and troubleshooting.

  

**Advertisement Content Management*** Validate advertisement content received from clients and agencies.
* Ensure content complies with technical specifications and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate content ingestion, transcoding, distribution, and deployment.
* Maintain advertisement content repositories and version controls.

  

**Playback Monitoring \& Compliance*** Track campaign playback through monitoring systems and playback logs.
* Investigate and resolve missed, delayed, or incomplete advertisement deliveries.
* Ensure contractual spot commitments are met across theatre networks.
* Generate proof\-of\-performance reports for clients and internal stakeholders.

  

**Billing \& Revenue Assurance*** Validate playback reports and campaign logs for invoicing purposes.
* Ensure accurate calculation of delivered spots and campaign performance metrics.
* Support revenue reconciliation and audit requirements.
* Minimize revenue leakage through operational controls and validations.

  

**MIS \& Reporting*** Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly campaign execution reports.
* Develop operational dashboards and performance scorecards.
* Monitor campaign KPIs and identify areas for improvement.
* Provide management with insights on inventory utilization and operational efficiency.

  

**Client \& Sales Support*** Partner with Sales teams during campaign planning and execution.
* Support clients with execution updates, campaign reports, and issue resolution.
* Participate in pre\-campaign feasibility assessments.
* Ensure service\-level agreements (SLAs) are consistently achieved.

  

**Process Improvement \& Automation*** Identify opportunities for operational efficiencies and automation.
* Develop SOPs and operational best practices.
* Collaborate with technology teams for system enhancements.
* Lead initiatives to improve campaign visibility, reporting accuracy, and operational productivity.

  

**Qualifications*** Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Media Management, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related field.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification preferred.

  

**Experience*** 5 to 10 years of experience in Advertisement Operations, Media Operations, Cinema Advertising, Broadcast Operations, or Digital Media Operations.
* Experience managing multi\-location campaign execution and reporting.
* Experience working with theatre networks, media agencies, and advertisers is preferred.

  

**Technical Skills*** Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Power BI
* SQL and Data Analysis
* Campaign Scheduling Systems
* ERP and CRM Platforms
* MIS Reporting and Dashboard Development
* Process Automation Tools

  

**Behavioral Competencies*** Strong Operational Management Skills
* Attention to Detail
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Focus
* Communication \& Coordination
* Time Management
* Decision Making
* Team Leadership

  

**Role Objective**  

To ensure flawless execution of cinema advertising campaigns across the theatre network through efficient content deployment, playback monitoring, client servicing, revenue assurance, reporting, and continuous process improvement, thereby maximizing client satisfaction and advertising revenue.

title: Data Acquisition and Reconciliation Operations, Assistant Vice President
description:
**Who we are looking for**

In this role, you will work with State Street teams from around the globe to lead Reconciliation team supporting State street Middle Office and back office services. You will have responsibility to oversee and deliver all day\-to\-day deliverables of the Reconciliation management team in a fast\-paced, flexible and exciting environment. The role will need to initiate and develop good communication and interpersonal relationship with business operations teams and IT and to maintain the high level of service that is currently being provided to all the clients.


**Why this role is important to us**

This is a varied operational and managerial position with a senior level of responsibility within the Reconciliation team. This Reconciliation Officer/Assistant Vice President acts as a Primary contact point for all internal/external clients. The team is responsible performing Cash, Position and Non\-Core reconciliation and support various functional teams to resolve the exception within SLA. The candidate should be a hands on manager who is required to ensure the teams under their responsibility undertake delivery to both internal and external clients, ensure timely response to client initiated queries, and escalation of any unresolve matters to manager for best resolution.


**What you will be responsible for**

* Oversee and provide day to day management of Reconciliation Management team for responsible Reconciliation unit/client
* Drive Reconciliation process excellence though proactive management of the exception lifecycle
* Responsible for service delivery and client sentiment, including direct client contact
* Support a strong risk management and control environment
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of standards, methodologies, processes, systems and technology necessary to support investment management operations.
* Conduct high\-level analysis in specific areas of expertise, identify and resolve work\-processing issues, make suggestions to streamline operations and implement.
* Liaise with colleagues in region or divisions globally where required for client issue resolution
* Perform an review function of Reconciliation process to identifying operational trends, issues and areas for improvement.
* Perform work independently within scope of established guidelines and according to specific procedures.
* Support and proactive manage on Client Change Request items impacting the Enterprise processes and Operating Models
* Communicate effectively on issues / problems to the Client and to SSC management and ensure a proper and timely follow\-up to ensure resolution.
* Provide guidance, support and development opportunities to the members of your team
* Excellent analytical skills and ability to analyze on the spot.

**What we value**

* Extensive asset management experience, including investment operations, reconciliations and fund accounting.
* Broad and in\-depth understanding of the asset management industry, gained through working in a variety of asset management disciplines.
* Strong critical thinking, problem solving, and decision making skills
* Hands\-on experience with reconciliation tools like TLP/IntelliMatch and proficiency in manual reconciliation processes.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to audiences of different sizes and levels of seniority
* Must be self\-motivated, adaptable and show initiative in different circumstances and under pressure
* Good team working skills.
* Flexibility in working outside of your responsibilities and areas of expertise.

**Education \& Preferred Qualifications:**

* Degree in finance, business, technology or equivalent with 15\+ yrs. of relevant industry experience
* Proven experience in client communication and interaction at all levels
* In depth understanding of Middle or Back Office operations, end\-to\-end processes of Mutual Funds, Hedge Funds, ETFs, and other investment vehicles. Should be proficient in multiple asset classes including derivatives, bank loans, fixed income, OTC products, etc., and have a deep understanding of their life cycles.
* Understanding of key technology within the support of investment management operations, TLM/TLP and Intellimatch.
* Experience of driving organizational change, with an understanding of change management principles, techniques \& tools.
* Experience in leveraging technology solutions including low\-code tools, SQL, Python or similar is advantageous
* Strong MS Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint skills necessary

**Additional requirements :** Working from office 4 days a week

Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.

title: Assistant / Deputy Manager – OFR Import Operations
description:
**ABOUT OCEAN FREIGHT OPERATIONS**


The Ocean Freight Operations team plays a pivotal role in managing all ocean\-bound imports and exports, utilizing a diverse range of equipment and services. The team collaborates closely with a network of ocean carriers, Procurement \& capacity management (PCM), and participating in major carrier alliances to secure planned space protection from key container ports globally. This meticulous coordination is essential for ensuring a reliable and efficient transportation process for ocean\-bound cargo.

  

**JOB SUMMARY**


As an integral part of Ocean Freight Import Operations, the incumbent role in ensuring the efficiency of import processes within the specified region. The role involves supporting the ocean\-bound cargo movements. It involves coordinating with various processes, including vessel scheduling, cargo documentation, interaction with ocean carriers to constantly strive for optimizing efficiency, regulations, and maintaining high standards of service.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Operational Excellence:**


* Ensure cost\-effective, high\-quality Import Ocean freight operations at satellite locations.
* Handle a high volume of files and meet tight deadlines without sacrificing quality.
* Co\-ordinate with Consignee, destination office for green light approval.
* Ensure operational compliance and error\-free documentation on a timely basis.
* Responsible for the smooth execution of Imports Operation functions.
* Increase customer satisfaction (both internal/external) with best\-in\-class services.
* Co\-ordinate with gateway/CFS/ICD team for timely de\-stuffing of containers.
* Proactively report and manage Ops. Irregularity within 24 hours for irregularities such as excess landing, short landing, damages, etc.
* Eliminate revenue leakage by plugging all possible gaps.
* Co\-ordinate with CBC team for timely clearance of DAP/DDU \& DDP shipments and delivery of shipments to the consignee.
* Coordinate with the team in closing transshipment bonds if any executed with the shipping line and customs.
* Release documents to customers according to agreed SOP/COP (Cash/Credit).
* Manage the vendor payment process and ensure shipment tracking.
* Avoid claims and penalties due to service failures.
* Handle customer complaints and overseas queries.
* Implement CW1 Best Practices, including auto rating, auto costing, timely and accurate estimation of costs, milestone updation, and file hygiene checks.
* Taking complete responsibility for independently managing customer accounts, guided by both supervisor and manager, following the 'one file, one operator' approach.

  

**Stakeholder Management:**


* Increase customer satisfaction with best\-in\-class services.
* Manage carrier, supplier, and network relationships.
* Interface with sales teams and customer service teams.
* Keep the customer service team informed about shipment\-related updates.

  

**Customer \& Network Support:**


* Record complaints concerning all import shipments.
* Undertake and assist in daily export operations tasks.
* Address and resolve network\-related issues.
* Maintain regular communication with sales and support teams.

  

**COMPETENCIES**


**Functional Competencies**


* Product Knowledge: Thorough knowledge of products, services, and logistics industry.
* Customer Service: Strong customer service skills to address inquiries, provide updates, and resolve issues related to shipments.
* Technology Proficiency: Implementing CW1 and other tools for optimizing operations.
* Customs Regulations Acumen: Understanding of customs procedures, tariff and international trade laws for industry regulations and standards.3

**Behavioral Competencies**


* Agility: Ability to adapt quickly to changing operational needs and environments.
* Continuous Learning: Willingness to learn and improve skills to enhance performance.
* Attention to Detail: Consistently maintaining accuracy and precision in tasks and documentation.
* Quality Orientation: Commitment to delivering high\-quality results and services.
* Initiative: Taking proactive steps to improve processes or address issues without waiting for direction.
* Team Collaboration: Collaborating across teams for smooth operations.

**WHO CAN APPLY?**


**Must Have**


* Bachelor’s degree in any field required.
* Proven experience in running smooth operations processes.
* 2\-3 years of experience in the shipping or logistics for Executive/ Sr. Executive.
* 4\-5 years of experience in the shipping/logistics industry for AM/DM.
* Basic problem\-solving skills to address common challenges.
* Proficient in Email writing and verbal communication with internal and external coordination.

  

**Preferred**


* Courses and certifications in business administration, operations management.
* Completed Cargo Basic and Dangerous Goods courses.

  

**Qualifies freshers are welcome.**

title: Manager II Program Management, Global Catalog Operations
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon.com operates in a global eCommerce environment without boundaries, and operates a diverse set of businesses worldwide, including Retail, third party marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, web services for developers.  

  

The Amazon product catalog is a set of records; each record being a set of facts describing a physical or digital product. These records are often organized by defined relationships (e.g. variations such as different sizes of the same shoe). Our ability to provide a good product discovery experience and empower our customers to make well informed purchase decisions is dependent on the quality of our product catalog. In a high quality catalog, every product is described with a complete, structured, accurate and correctly normalized set of facts. Every product is represented by a unique record appropriately related to one another.  

The Global catalog operations (GCO) team is part of Amazon Selection \& Catalog services (ASCS) teams in India focus on leveraging human intelligence, external or internal, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog: Global catalog operations (GCO) charter is to make Catalog engineering programs more effective by providing expert human judgment. Catalog Operations from its inception has been partnering with engineering teams to run programs focused on improving the data quality of catalog in all market places.
  

  

We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1\) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMES and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2\) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3\) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4\) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Manager II, Program Management you will:  

  

* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team
* Drive quantitative, data\-oriented decision making across the portfolio and champion the adoption of technology solutions and process improvements
* Communicate program progress, risks, and results to senior leadership, ensuring transparency and alignment with key business goals
* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in\-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business
* Ensure effective risk controls are developed and maintained across programs, with corrective actions that keep commitments on track and minimize losses
* Develop and influence new ideas, establishing procedures and practices that promote long\-term, scalable solutions in dynamic environments
* Drive continuous improvement and decision\-making strategies across the team and the broader function
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* 5\+ years of team management experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
* Experience in data mining, data management, reporting, and SQL queries

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Laundry Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description** Sunshine Integrated Facility Management and Laundry Care Services was established on August 6, 2006, with a vision to deliver reliable and high\-quality support services to organizations across multiple industries. The group focuses on sustainable growth, customer\-centric solutions, and long\-term partnerships. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, drive improvements, and support strategic initiatives. The company values integrity, accountability, and collaborative work, creating opportunities for professional development and advancement.

**Laundry Operations Manager (Hospital) – Roles, Responsibilities, and NABH/JCI Alignment**

A Laundry Operations Manager in a hospital setting oversees the end\-to\-end processing of patient linens, staff uniforms, surgical textiles, curtains, and related items. The role prioritizes infection prevention, timely supply, quality control, staff management, equipment reliability, and compliance with accreditation standards. Hospital experience is essential due to the high infection\-control requirements.

**Operational Oversight**

* Manage daily laundry operations: collection/sorting of soiled linen, washing, drying, ironing/folding, packaging, and distribution to wards, OT, ICU, and other departments.
* Ensure proper segregation of soiled, infectious/contaminated (e.g., blood/body fluids, isolation), and non\-infectious linen at source and in the laundry.
* Maintain adequate clean linen supply (PAR levels), track utilization, losses, damages, and replacements.
* Coordinate collection and delivery schedules to meet departmental needs without stockouts.
* Implement and monitor Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the full workflow.

**Infection Prevention \& Quality Control**

* Enforce infection control protocols throughout handling, processing, transport, and storage to prevent cross\-contamination.
* Oversee quality checks for cleanliness, stains, damage, and hygienic standards.
* Ensure unidirectional workflow (dirty → clean) with physical separation of areas.
* Conduct or oversee regular inspections, microbiological testing where required, and validation of processes.

**Staff Management**

* Supervise, schedule, train, and evaluate laundry staff.
* Provide training on infection control, PPE use, safe handling of contaminated linen, equipment operation, and hygiene.
* Foster teamwork, monitor performance, and handle recruitment/onboarding as needed.
* Ensure staff follow PPE protocols, hand hygiene, and occupational health requirements (e.g., vaccinations).

**Equipment, Inventory \& Maintenance**

* Oversee proper use, preventive maintenance, and repair of washers, dryers, ironers, and related equipment.
* Coordinate with engineering/maintenance for breakdowns and servicing schedules.
* Manage inventory of detergents, disinfectants, chemicals, bags, and supplies; control costs and ordering.
* Track equipment performance and ensure compliance with manufacturer recommendations.

**Budget, Compliance \& Administration**

* Prepare and manage departmental budget; control costs while meeting quality and volume targets.
* Maintain records/logs for production, inventory, temperature/chemical dosing, maintenance, incidents, and audits.
* Ensure compliance with hospital policies, occupational safety, and regulatory requirements.
* Act as liaison with infection control, nursing, CSSD, housekeeping, and external contractors (if outsourced).
* Support quality improvement, KPI tracking (e.g., turnaround time, linen loss rates, complaint resolution), and accreditation readiness.
* Handle customer service issues from user departments and continuous process improvement.

**Typical Qualifications**

* Diploma/Degree in laundry management, housekeeping, facilities/hospitality management, or related field; preference for healthcare experience.
* 3–7\+ years progressive experience in laundry operations, with strong preference (or requirement) for hospital/healthcare laundry.
* Knowledge of infection control, thermal/chemical disinfection, and healthcare textile standards.
* Leadership, organizational, and communication skills; ability to work in a fast\-paced, high\-stakes enviro

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Manager – Financial Operations
description:
Management Level


F
EQ Retirement Solutions is transforming the retirement and pensions markets with leading administration and technology solutions. With over 1200 employees globally, 189 years of knowledge and 11 million pension scheme members and policyholders, we are here to help people plan for a confident financial future by delivering innovative, reliable and customer\-focused retirement services. Our teams are driven by a shared commitment to excellence, collaboration and making a real impact to the lives of our clients and customers.


**Role Overview**

**Manager – Financial Operations**

The Manager, Financial Operations is responsible for the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of all finance activities processed through the organisation's Workday/ERP platform. The role acts as the global process owner for Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and direct oversight of UK Payroll processes, ensuring accurate transaction processing, timely financial reporting, strong controls, and optimal use of Workday/ERP capabilities.


The successful candidate will be a strong people leader with the ability to develop high\-performing teams, build organisational capability, and drive a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer focus.


**Core Duties/Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:


**Operational Leadership \& Process Ownership**

* Lead the delivery of finance operations across Procure\-to\-Pay (PTP), Record\-to\-Report (RTR), Fixed Assets, and Payroll processes.
* Own operational performance, ensuring delivery against SLAs, KPIs, quality standards, and customer expectations.
* Ensure standardised, efficient, and well\-controlled end\-to\-end finance processes.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for operational issues and process exceptions.

**People Management**

* Lead, develop, and motivate a high\-performing Finance Operations team.
* Provide coaching, mentoring, and career development opportunities to enhance capability and engagement.
* Drive talent management, succession planning, and skills development to ensure long\-term organisational resilience.

**Accounts Payable Operations**

* Oversee invoice processing, payment execution, employee expenses, and supplier account management.
* Ensure timely supplier payments and effective resolution of payment\-related issues.
* Maintain strong AP controls, compliance, and governance standards.
* Act as the functional owner for Workday Accounts Payable processes and enhancements.

**Record\-to\-Report Operations**

* Ensure timely and accurate journal processing and financial accounting activities.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, capitalisation, depreciation, and asset lifecycle management.
* Manage balance sheet reconciliations, bank reconciliations, and prepayment accounting.
* Support statutory, audit, and compliance requirements.
* Drive continuous improvements across RTR processes to improve efficiency, control, and reporting quality.

**Procurement Operations**

* Manage Purchase Order (PO) support processes.
* Oversee supplier onboarding activities and vendor master governance.
* Support procurement compliance and policy adherence.
* Partner with stakeholders to drive efficient purchasing processes.
* Support supplier negotiations and process optimisation initiatives.

**Payroll Operations (UK)**

* Oversee UK payroll processing, validation, reconciliations, and payroll accounting activities.
* Ensure payroll operations are delivered accurately, compliantly, and on time.
* Review payroll journals, controls, and exception management processes.
* Ensure timely resolution of payroll queries and exceptions.
* Partner with HR and external providers to maintain a high\-quality payroll service.

**Workday/ERP Governance \& Optimisation**

* Act as the Finance SME for Workday/ERP processes and functionality.
* Drive maximum utilisation of system capabilities through automation and process standardisation.
* Partner with Technology and Business teams on system enhancements and process changes.

**Performance Management \& Reporting**

* Develop and maintain KPI dashboards and operational reporting.
* Monitor productivity, service levels, quality, and control metrics.
* Analyse performance trends and recommend corrective actions.
* Provide regular management information to Finance leadership.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Simplify workflows to improve efficiency, accuracy, and customer experience.
* Drive a culture of operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Support Finance transformation and change initiatives.

**Skills, Knowledge \& Experience**

The successful candidate will demonstrate the following experience skills and behaviours:


**EXPERIENCE:**

* Strong experience across Finance Operations, Shared Services, or Financial Accounting environments.
* End\-to\-end knowledge of Procure\-to\-Pay, Record\-to\-Report, Fixed Assets, and UK Payroll processes.
* Experience of operating and optimising ERP platforms, preferably Workday.
* Strong understanding of Month\-End and year\-end financial close processes.
* Experience delivering operational excellence, automation, and process transformation initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across multiple functions and levels.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making capabilities.
* Ability to lead change and deliver results in a fast\-paced environment.

**EDUCATION/QUALIFICATIONS:**

* MBA (Finance) or Postgraduate qualification in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management or CA \\ CMA inter or equivalent
* Professional accounting qualification (CA, CMA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA) or equivalent

**SKILLS:**

* Fluent English: written and spoken.
* Proven Leadership abilities and team working
* Excellent organizational, communication and planning skills
* Professional, credible individual with an ability to influence peers, superiors and subordinates
* Adaptable with an ability to change direction and priorities if required
* Achievement orientation: Driven by goals and deadlines
* Ability to work well with people across the organisation.
* Ability to understand the detail behind processes.
